content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Street sweepers, mowers and farm equipment for municipalities and farmers; no asphalt, aggregate or mining equipment overlap."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Utility smart meters, filtration and aerospace components; different products and customers from road and quarry equipment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Distributor of plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors; it does not manufacture road or quarry equipment."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Designs and builds asphalt plants and aftermarket parts for road builders and asphalt producers, matching Astec's core product and customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake pads and connectors for process and transport industries; not asphalt, aggregate or mining equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Industrial engines and generator sets sold to equipment makers; a component supplier rather than a road and quarry machine builder."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical fluids, lubricants and coatings sold for metalworking; a chemicals business, not equipment."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hinges, security hardware and metal castings for manufacturers; a hardware and components business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Bearings and power transmission components sold to vehicle and machinery makers; a component business, not plant or machine builder."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Mainly turf mowers, irrigation and snow equipment for landscapers and homeowners; its Ditch Witch drilling line is only a minor part."}]}
